title: Provenance Is Future Memory
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: Provenance is future memory when it preserves a transparent chain of identity, custody, intervention, attribution, evidence, uncertainty, and rights—not merely a prestigious prior owner.
Dress is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
narrativeSequence.rights: Object record marks the image Public Domain; retain full credit and identifier.

narrativeSequence.caption: 01 · IDENTITY — Is this the same object?. Record stable identifier, components, marks, labels, measurements, materials, images, condition, alterations, and comparison basis; note uncertainty and separated parts.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · CHAIN — Can each custody event be evidenced?. Attach acquisition, gift, inheritance, loan, sale, deposit, return, location, responsible party, document, date, and restriction without inventing missing links.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · INTERVENE — What changed the object or record?. Log repair, conservation, cleaning, alteration, reframing, digitization, renaming, reattribution, exhibition, reproduction, and metadata correction.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · CLAIM — How confident is the story?. Label verified fact, physical observation, attributed conclusion, participant account, inference, disputed statement, and unresolved gap; retain earlier versions and correction history.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
